content:
Priya: Heads-up: OrionHealth asked for a joint launch + webinar. Target publish/webinar week: May 10. Need to lock messaging, speaker lineup, and lead routing to SFDC campaign before we confirm. Who can take point on registration copy and follow-up sequence?
Jules: I can run registration copy + ops. Need final hero sentence and preferred CTA. Also will ask Sam for 2 speakers (engineer + product).
Ari: Draft hero sentence: "How OrionHealth cut inference cost and improved throughput for real-time clinical scoring." Will do 2 variants: enterprise tone + developer tone. Sending both shortly.
Dan: Bench ask: what's the target workload? We'll bench using Llama-2-7b-v2 quantized on g5dn-equivalent instances; metric set: median latency, tail latency, and tokens/sec under 12 concurrent streams. Will publish methodology appendix.
Mei: Legal: need signed release for quotes and a data redaction checklist. No PHI in examples or screenshots. If Orion wants any patient example, it must be fully synthetic. Also we'll need to approve social headlines.
Rowan: Event ops: I'll draft run-of-show + rehearsal slot. Prefer 45-min prep rehearsal a day before. Also confirm streaming provider (Vimeo vs Zoom Webinar). Jules 13 which do you prefer?
Jules: Zoom Webinar works for us. Rowan, will you own the panelist invites?
Rowan: Yep.
Priya: Action items:
- Jules: customer outreach + registration copy (due Apr 20)
- Dan: bench run + upload artifacts (due Apr 25)
- Ari: draft blog + slide narrative + social variants (due Apr 22)
- Mei: release & redaction checklist + template (due Apr 24)
- Rowan: rehearsal scheduling + webinar ops (due May 7)
Please react with :white_check_mark: if task accepted.
leadgen-bot: Suggested SFDC campaign: "OrionHealth Case + Webinar May10". Want to auto-tag registrants with utm_campaign=orion-webinar; set owner to Growth Webinars.
Jules: Reached out to Sam at 11:02. Message: "Hi Sam 12 we'd love to feature OrionHealth in a short case + co-hosted webinar. Proposed windows May 10 or May 12. Would you be able to provide an engineer and a PM? We'll provide release form and slides to review."
Sam: (from Orion) Thanks, we can do May 10. Engineer + PM available. Need to see the release and the exact data you'll publish.
Jules: Great. Sent release draft and the data checklist. Sam replied: "We can share benchmarks but will need one metric anonymized (patient cohort counts) and no patient identifiers. Also legal needs 48h to sign."
Mei: Understood. I'll prepare a short customer release: includes a quote line, publication date, and a section where customer can mark redactions. Will send to Jules for customer.
Dan: I started the bench uploads: https://drive.example/orion/bench/2026-04-05-results.csv and runbook: https://drive.example/orion/bench/runbook.md. Note: warmup=500 tokens, batch=4 for steady-state numbers.
Ari: Putting together the blog draft. Early hero options: 
- Dev tone: "OrionHealth scaled real-time inference for clinical scoring with Redwood Inference."
- Enterprise tone: "Reliable, compliant inference for health systems at scale."
Also drafting social copy: "Join our webinar w/ @OrionHealth to see how real-time scoring became production-ready. Register: <link>"
Jules: Uploading registration draft: https://marketing.example/campaigns/orion-draft. Includes speaker bios placeholders.
Priya: Reminder: ensure the webinar registration form has the correct lead fields: company, role, use-case, deployment interest (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). We need this to route to AE queue properly.
leadgen-bot: Routing rule: If attendee selects "Private" or "Dedicated" -> route to Enterprise AE queue; else -> Growth SDR queue. Also tag with "orion-case" for nurturing list.
Rowan: I'll add a prep doc for speakers: 10-min show notes for Orion speaker + slide notes. Also propose a 15-min internal dry-run with Redwood presenters on May 8.
Sam: Quick Q: can you remove a row from the bench CSV that contains internal cohort size? We prefer to anonymize counts (e.g., "<5000").
Mei: Acceptable to replace exact counts with ranges. Jules, include that option on the release form so customer can pick.
Jules: Noted, I'll update the release and resend.
Ari: For the blog, do we want a small technical appendix with commands + a docker image tag? Might help developer adoption.
Dan: Yes, add a reproducibility appendix. I'll add a gist with the exact run command and seed.
Priya: Deadline reminders: once we have signed release and final slides, we lock the registration page and open promo window (two weeks prior to webinar). If legal delay pushes us, we shift promo accordingly.
Jules: Sam signed the release at 16:48. They picked anonymize counts option. Sending confirmation to team.
calendar-bot: Event created: "OrionHealth: Case Study + Webinar" May 10 09:00 PT 12 https://calendar.example/e/68721
Rowan: Draft run-of-show posted: 
1) 3m intros
2) 10m Redwood technical overview + benchmark highlights
3) 12m Orion case talk
4) 7m demo/screenshots (anonymized)
5) 8m live Q&A
Jules: Registration page live draft: https://marketing.example/campaigns/orion-live-draft. Need hero sentence choice by EOD Apr 22.
Ari: Picking dev tone + second enterprise variant. Posting both in doc.
Dan: Uploaded the reproducibility gist: https://gist.example/orionbench. Please don't publish gist until we confirm redactions.
Mei: Final legal note: We'll sign off on the combined assets (blog + slides + registration copy) once redactions applied and customer confirms. Expect check in 24h after I send redline.
Priya: Thanks team. If anything slips, ping me and I'll escalate with CSM to unblock Orion.
leadgen-bot: Campaign created in SFDC: ID 0x4f2a. Default owner: Growth Webinars.
Jules: Promo plan draft: email -> partners -> organic social -> paid. Will share channel calendar by Apr 26.
Priya: Closing checklist (pre-publish):
- Signed release (done)
- Redacted bench CSV (done)
- Final slides (due May 3)
- Rehearsal scheduled (May 9)
- Registration open (planned Apr 26)
React with :rocket: when you confirm assets are ready.
Rowan: :rocket:
Ari: :rocket:
Dan: :rocket:
Mei: :white_check_mark:
Jules: :rocket:
